description: Fleet-wide consistency sweep across every repo in the fleet manifest: stray branches/worktrees, unmerged PRs, red CI, stale flake.lock pins, Nix store garbage, and unactivated host generations (macos). Use when asked to "clean up the fleet", "sync everything", "is everything in sync", "garbage collect and activate", or after a multi-repo change (identity rename, secret rotation, cross-repo pin bump) that needs to land and propagate everywhere. Composes git-purity, pr-title, nix-hygiene (for nix-config itself), and the existing activate/GC tooling — not a replacement for any of them.
